method: Separate post-draft read of the saved text against the exact archive receipts, actual audit, original panel votes and proposed source withdrawal record.
score_reason: Measured facts and clear scope; formal artifact terminology and repeated boundaries are appropriate but somewhat mechanical.
confidence_reason: Editorial self-assessment, not an authorship or detector claim.

examples.impact: Reader sees that this archive or draft cannot be submitted.
examples.quote: **This archive is withdrawn as a submission candidate.** Pat found two installed-help descriptions that promise GNN training or comparison despite the baseline-only default. PR #238 corrects those descriptions and generated help. Its proposed source and provisional installation passed independent review; merge, deployment, a new frozen archive and corresponding checks remain required. The old archive and all raw evidence remain unchanged.

science_gate_reason: No new scientific result; proper-imputation and fixed-effect pooling bounds remain explicit.
facts_gate_reason: Archive identity, native counts/timings and original panel state match retained receipts; withdrawn state prevents readiness inference.
references_gate_reason: The DOI/Crossref claim is bound to retained primary metadata and the unresolved resolver403; no new licence or acceptance assertion.
calibration_status: Protocol and template examples read; no held-out style evaluation.
